'''Dag Feraan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who sold military gear on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] during the stage of the [[Galactic War]] known as the [[Conquest of Makeb]].
